fato_historico: 2009: The ro-ro ferry SuperFerry 9 sinks off the Zamboanga Peninsula in the Philippines with 971 persons aboard; all but ten are rescued.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to reflect on the strength found in connection. Much like a gentle tide bringing calm after a storm, today's energy may highlight your innate ability to gather those you love. Consider reaching out to your community, as shared experiences may offer profound comfort and remind you of the miraculous, enduring power of human hope and unity.
frase_do_dia: Even when the tides turn, your inner light guides the way to safety.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of cycles and the arrival of new wisdom.
conselho: Trust your instincts and cherish the safety found within your supportive circle today.
